text: For ninety years Renfield has eaten bugs for strength and [brought victims to Count Dracula, who abuses him|wrong|cruelty at home]. Lying low in New Orleans while his master recuperates, he finds a support group for people in codependent relationships and begins to want a life of his own. Dracula [craves the blood of the pure|wants|the sacrifice demanded] and [slaughters the friends Renfield made in the group|who_suffers|friends and companions]. Police officer Rebecca Quincy joins Renfield against the Lobo crime family and a master [whom sunlight can still wound|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
